problem_context.problem_statement: Verify the simplest read-only AVL operation: search a valid AVL graph for an integer key without modifying the represented tree.
problem_context.expected_behavior: Return a valid node whose data equals key when the key occurs in the AVL model; otherwise return NULL. Preserve the complete AVL representation and graph model.
problem_context.input_output_contract: Input owns avl_rep g and data is an int. Output preserves avl_rep g and satisfies avl_search_result g data ret.
spec_hint: Use the existing graph-based avl_model, avl_rep, and avl_search_result from xizi_avl_graph_lib. The recursive invariant should move to the selected child model while framing the untouched graph ownership; do not mirror the C recursion in Rocq.
preferred_hidden_properties: BST ordering makes the discarded subtree unable to contain the searched key; recursive search preserves avl_rep g.
forbidden_patterns: Do not weaken the postcondition to pointer nullness or shape only, and do not define a second recursive AVL search algorithm in Rocq.
reference_case_hints: Use only QCP_demos_LLM graph/BST and direct recursive search patterns; never inspect QCP_demos_human.
